@GarryCreates 

Life, the Universe, and Restaurants is scheduled for release in 2026, and the latest demo is now available on Steam.
This is a space restaurant management sim where you cook for the gods.
It blends management and automation, letting you place robot assistants to keep up with the gods’ ever-escalating demands.
And when an angry god comes to destroy your restaurant, you can fight back with a meat cleaver. With darkly comic touches like brain harvesting and disguising space cockroaches as ingredients, the game is packed with hardcore black humor.
